name: type a name press enter
say: Creating is one gesture: type a name, press Enter — that's a tile. Type three more names — that's a structure. This is how everything gets built, including how Hypercomb documents itself: every feature gets a mirror in the hive — tiles for its parts, notes explaining them, pheromone marks classifying them. The hive isn't documentation about the system; the hive is the living specification of the system. In fact, the presentation tile you just watched being created is this very presentation, mirrored into the hive, with its three chapters as children.
